[``` \begin{aligned} \frac{3^{3-1}+3\abs{9-10}}{\sqrt{3+18\div3}}\amp=\frac{3^{\nextoperation{3-1}}+3\abs{\nextoperation{9-10}}}{\sqrt{3+\nextoperation{18\div3}}}\\ \amp=\frac{3^{\highlight{2}}+3\nextoperation{\abs{\highlight{-1}}}}{\sqrt{\nextoperation{3+\highlight{6}}}}\\ \amp=\frac{\nextoperation{3^2}+3(\highlight{1})}{\sqrt{\highlight{9}}}\\ \amp=\frac{\highlight{9}+\nextoperation{3(1)}}{\nextoperation{\sqrt{9}}}\\ \amp=\frac{\nextoperation{9+\highlight{3}}}{\highlight{3}}\\ \amp=\frac{\highlight{12}}{3}=\highlight{4} \end{aligned} ```]
